name: account-menu
title: Account Menu
description: AccountMenu: the signed-in user in a Shell or topbar. The trigger shows an avatar (or initials) and the name, which hides on narrow screens; the menu has a header with the name, email and an optional role Badge, your app entries (Devices, Security, Invite) and sign-out, which can ask first through ConfirmDialog, whose confirm then needs a person's approval for agents.
docs: `<Shell actions={<AccountMenu user={{ name, email, avatarSrc }} roleLabel="Admin" items={[{ value: "devices", label: "Devices", icon: <MonitorSmartphoneIcon />, onSelect: () => router.push("/devices") }]} signOutLabel="Sign out" onSignOut={signOut} confirmSignOut={{ title: "Sign out?", confirmLabel: "Sign out now", agentConfirm: "Signs you out of this device" }} />} />`. It goes in the Shell's `actions`, the topbar's end, which stays put whether the sidebar is a rail, hidden or a drawer, or in any Topbar's `trailing`. An item's `onSelect` that returns a Promise keeps it pending and the menu open until it settles, and so does `onSignOut`. Agents press the trigger with an item's text (`press` with "Devices"); with `confirmSignOut`, the dialog's confirm button carries `data-agent-confirm`, so an agent's sign-out waits for your `allow` (the mark sits on the button that confirms, not on the menu item that opens the dialog, so a person is asked once). `labels.trigger(name)` names the trigger ("Account: Ana Ruiz" by default).
